system: You are an analyst who writes clear, concise business reports.
prompt:
Write a report of 5 to 8 sentences for the sales team at Bluefen on sales results for Q3 2026, based on this data.

Company: Bluefen
Period: Q3 2026

Data:
- Average order value: 110.72 GBP
- Average order value in the previous quarter: 118.35 GBP
- Change in average order value vs the previous quarter: -6.4%
- New customers: 616 customers
- New customers in the previous quarter: 1,086 customers
- Change in new customers vs the previous quarter: -43.3%
- Return rate: 2.7%
- Change in return rate vs the previous quarter, in percentage points: 1.7 pp
- Online orders: 15,618 orders
- Online orders in the previous quarter: 13,699 orders
- Change in online orders vs the previous quarter: 14.0%
- Revenue: 16.6 million GBP
- Revenue in the previous quarter: 15.6 million GBP
- Change in revenue vs the previous quarter: 6.3%
- Verdict on the change in average order value vs the previous quarter: a mild drop

Notes for the report:
[s1] Sales team note, "Seasonal campaign": The Summer Rush campaign started on May 3 in Calgary and Leeds, with discounts of up to 40% on home goods.

Use only the information in the data: do not add figures, names, causes or predictions that are not there. Write only the report, in prose, with no headings or lists.
raw: The Q3 2026 results show a mild drop in average order value to £110.72, a 6.4% decline from the previous quarter. New customer acquisition fell sharply to 616, down 43.3% quarter‑on‑quarter. The return rate rose to 2.7%, an increase of 1.7 percentage points. Online orders grew by 14.0% to 15,618, driving revenue up 6.3% to £16.6 million. The Summer Rush campaign, launched on May 3 in Calgary and Leeds with discounts of up to 40% on home goods, contributed to the higher order volume. Despite the higher volume, the lower average order value and reduced new‑customer count offset some of the revenue gains.
